(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix User. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/manage-team-members/."
access_type  SingleNestedAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "Access type configuration - defines whether user access is permanent or temporary with expiration"
    plan modifier: objectplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
    validator: user.oneOfArmsValidator At most one arm of each one-of group can be set, and exactly one when the group needs an arm.
access_type.permanent_access  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Permanent access configuration - user has indefinite access"
access_type.temporary_access  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Temporary access configuration - user access expires at a specified time"
access_type.temporary_access.expire_at  StringAttribute optional custom=timetypes.RFC3339Type
    markdown: "Timestamp when the user's temporary access will expire. After this time, the user will no longer be able to access the system."
active  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Whether the user is active. The provider manages the whole status of the user through this attribute: `false` deactivates the user, `true` activates them. It defaults to `true`."
allowed_login_mode  ListAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "List of allowed login modes. Can include SSO, local authentication, or both. The order and repetitions of the configuration are kept in the state: the backend answers them in its own order, and the resource matches the configuration to that answer when it reads. Removing the attribute from the configuration keeps the modes the backend has; clearing them takes an explicit empty list `[]`."
    plan modifier: listplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
groups  SetAttribute computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "The ids of the groups the user belongs to, as decimal strings, the values SCIM returned in groups[].value. A user with no memberships has a known empty set."
    plan modifier: setplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "User ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  SingleNestedAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "The name of the user."
    plan modifier: objectplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name.family_name  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The family (last) name of the user."
name.given_name  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "The given (first) name of the user."
user_name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "User name (email). Comparison is case-insensitive: when the backend normalizes the letter case of an SSO login, the read matches the state and plans no change. A configuration that changes the letter case of the name plans an update; the API keeps the stored name and the read keeps the spelling of the configuration. A configuration that changes the name itself fails: the API ignores a username change."
